deploy_proof.summary: RiderChangeContain + rider-only OCLSpecialPower is proven equivalent to stock DeployStyleAIUpdate + WeaponSet Conditions = DEPLOYED for pack/unpack and fire-only-when-deployed. CommandSet swap and SET_SLUGGISH-while-deployed are not.
proven: Two rider slots encode packed vs deployed weapon flags.
Packed uses SET_NORMAL; deployed uses SET_SLUGGISH (CWC-only switch).
WeaponSet WEAPON_RIDER1 PRIMARY None / WEAPON_RIDER2 PRIMARY HQ11MissileWeapon maps 1:1 onto stock Conditions = None vs DEPLOYED.
HQ11.HQ11 ONCE_BACKWARDS (packed) vs ONCE with MISSILE_C (deployed) stays on the same W3D.
OCL_CWCruSpecialAbilityFakeRider_Inf_Stand: OCL only injects the fake rider inside the vehicle
SpecialAbilityCWCruFakeRider_Inf_Stand uses SPECIAL_CIA_INTELLIGENCE; it must not be imported (would hijack CIA intel).
OCL_CWCruSpecialAbilityFakeRider_Inf_Prone: OCL only injects the fake rider inside the vehicle
SpecialAbilityCWCruFakeRider_Inf_Prone uses SPECIAL_CIA_INTELLIGENCE; it must not be imported (would hijack CIA intel).
OCLSpecialPower exists only to inject fake riders; stock Command_Deploy replaces it.
V25 itself already authors DeployStyleAIUpdate (e.g. SDSR5) in the same vehicle INI.

limitations.capability: Runtime CommandSet swap (packed vs deployed button labels)
limitations.v25: RiderChangeContain overrides CommandSet per rider (CWCruS300CommandSet vs DeployedCommandSet).
limitations.stock: DeployStyleAIUpdate does not swap CommandSet. One unique CommandSet with Command_Deploy + Command_Stop.
limitations.kept: State swap (pack/unpack) stays. Separate SHIFANG/BUSHU labels collapse to one Deploy toggle.

limitations.v25: Rider2 binds SET_SLUGGISH CWCruS300DeployedLocomotor so the TEL can crawl while unpacked.
limitations.stock: DeployStyleAIUpdate does not switch LocomotorSet. The unit packs, then moves on SET_NORMAL.
limitations.kept: Settled firing posture is kept. Slow-move-while-deployed is not available on stock Generals.exe.

limitations.v25: CWC rider swap timing is not an INI PackTime; ScuttleDelay=1500 is TOPPLED scuttle, not pack.
limitations.stock: PackTime = UnpackTime = 2000 copied from V25 SDSR5 DeployStyleAIUpdate in the same ChinaVehicle.ini.
limitations.kept: Pack/unpack exists. Exact CWC millisecond timing is not claimed.
